```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded value'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <?pi-target processing instruction data?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- Top level comment before CDATA and entity reference -->
  <ns2:child ns2:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags> and entities &internal;
    ]]>
  </ns2:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book+)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY pub "O'Reilly Media">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-macro "<!ENTITY macro-ent 'Macro Content'>">
  %dtd-macro;
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Catalog root comment -->
  <book xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com/book1">
    <title><![CDATA[Advanced XML & Parsing]]></title>
    <author>&pub; - &macro-ent;</author>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Entity 1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; and Entity 2">
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>">
  %pe;
  <?target-pi data="value"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="urn:doc:base" xmlns:m="urn:doc:meta" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment enclosing namespace and CDATA usage -->
  <m:metadata>
    <![CDATA[
      <m:info>Some metadata &e1; inside cdata</m:info>
    ]]>
  </m:metadata>
  <section>&e2;</section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY local 'local-entity'>">
  %param;
  <!ENTITY external-ref SYSTEM "file:///dev/null">
  <?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://www.example.org/archive" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Archive description comment -->
  <item dc:title="Test Item">
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed CDATA block with entity reference &local;
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&external-ref;</item>
</archive>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (setting)*>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base-url "http://localhost/">
  <!ENTITY full-url "&base-url;api">
  <!NOTATION text-plain SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY sample-file SYSTEM "sample.txt" NDATA text-plain>
  <?app-pi debug="true" mode="verbose"?>
]>
<config xmlns="http://xml.company.com/config" xmlns:cfg="http://xml.company.com/config/internal">
  <!-- Configuration root element comment -->
  <cfg:setting name="endpoint">
    <![CDATA[
      Endpoint URL is &full-url;
    ]]>
  </cfg:setting>
  <setting>&full-url;</setting>
</config>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE svg PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD SVG 1.1//EN" "http://www.w3.org/Graphics/SVG/1.1/DTD/svg11.dtd" [
  <!ENTITY % extra-defs "<!ENTITY brand 'Acme Corp'>">
  %extra-defs;
  <!ENTITY logo-text "Copyright &brand;">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="svg.css"?>
]>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Vector graphics root comment -->
  <desc>
    <![CDATA[
      SVG Graphic created by &logo-text; with <complex> tags.
    ]]>
  </desc>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="80" height="80" fill="blue"/>
</svg>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE notes [
  <!ELEMENT notes (note+)>
  <!ELEMENT note (title, body)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY urgent "URGENT WARNING">
  <!ENTITY % inline-macro "<!ENTITY nested 'Nested &urgent;'>">
  %inline-macro;
  <?note-app action="initialize"?>
]>
<notes xmlns="http://xml.notes.org/schema" xmlns:ns="http://xml.notes.org/ns">
  <!-- Comment before notes container -->
  <note>
    <title>
      <![CDATA[
        Important Notice: &urgent;
      ]]>
    </title>
    <body ns:priority="high">&nested;</body>
  </note>
</notes>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY rec-id "REC-2023-001">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-struct "
    <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
    <!ENTITY internal-macro 'MacroData'>
  ">
  %dtd-struct;
  <?db-info connection="sqlite" status="active"?>
]>
<database xmlns="http://db.org/schema" xmlns:db="http://db.org/schema/db">
  <!-- Database entries comment block -->
  <db:record id="&rec-id;">
    <![CDATA[
      Record content with internal macro &internal-macro; and special chars <>&
    ]]>
  </db:record>
</database>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (header, content)>
  <!ELEMENT header (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT content (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author-name "Jane Doe">
  <!ENTITY co-author "John Smith">
  <!ENTITY team "&author-name; and &co-author;">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY datasheet SYSTEM "spec.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <?xml-custom-pi target="start" value="processing"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://xml.document.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://xml.document.org/meta">
  <!-- Document header metadata comment -->
  <header meta:department="Engineering">
    <![CDATA[
      Prepared by team: &team;
    ]]>
  </header>
  <content>Main document body text referencing &team;</content>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY stock-status "In Stock">
  <!ENTITY % conditional-decl "<!ENTITY item-type 'Hardware'>">
  %conditional-decl;
  <?inventory-control warehouse="WH-4"?>
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://schemas.inventory.org/v1" xmlns:inv="http://schemas.inventory.org/v1/meta">
  <!-- Inventory manifest comment block -->
  <item inv:category="&item-type;">
    <![CDATA[
      Item status: &stock-status; with <tag> syntax inside CDATA
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>Status was: &stock-status;</item>
</inventory>
